keyObservation: Identical pattern to R0005, same run, different iteration, different random typing content and node ids: client index 1 (firefox) diverges by having ~258 MORE nodes than everyone else, while chromium/webkit/server all agree exactly. Two independent occurrences in the same 8-run batch, both implicating the SAME array slot (and therefore the same browser engine, since slot-to-engine mapping was fixed for this whole run). This strengthens, but does not yet prove, the 'Firefox-specific' hypothesis over the 'array-slot/timing-artifact' hypothesis — see R0005's recommendedNextStep (slot permutation) for how to actually distinguish them.
